note: Liquid mercury beside water (a look at how the renderer draws a metal, Stage 78): 300 g of mercury (22 mL) in a 50 mL beaker, beside a 50 mL beaker of water and one of copper sulfate (0.4 mol/kg). Mercury is its measured complex index n + ik (Inagaki, Arakawa and Williams 1981): what comes to it is turned back by Fresnel's reflectance, about 0.78 at every visible wavelength, and none goes in, so it shows the room as a curved mirror does. Mercury here has no vapour, and liquids mix ideally (it is not to be poured into water).
